title: Software Development Engineer III, Logistics API
descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What We Do

Our team is responsible for the Directions and Logistics APIs, which power everything from a single driver's route request to the complex logistics optimization for major delivery companies. We handle millions of requests daily, operating under strict latency requirements, making our work both challenging and highly rewarding. Given the essential nature of our services, we maintain a responsible on-call rotation and treat alarms seriously to ensure system stability without excessive noise.
We have an exciting roadmap for 2026, and this is the perfect time to join us to be a part of this exciting journey!

As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include a discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.

What You’ll Do

As a Staff Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing and operating significant areas of our routing services. In this role, you can expect to:

  • Design and implement scalable services for our API and routing engine tiers, following best practices for deployment, resilience, and observability.

  • Design and improve services that power the data consumption and storage of the routing data.

  • Drive the design, development, and testing of Mapbox tools

  • Shape internal tools and automations to make the whole engineering life easier and fun.

  • Drive design and development of services quality metrics and analytics.

  • Run and design experiments to evaluate the quality, reliability, and capacity requirements of our user-facing navigation products.

  • Participate in end-to-end feature implementation within the larger navigation team; review code and design documents, shepherd feature releases, and participate in an on-call rotation.

  • Work with product owners, sales engineering, and management to drive future product direction.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 12/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

Navigation API services interact with many internal systems at Mapbox, making this a high-visibility team with great opportunities to collaborate across the company.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 5+ years of experience in engineering web services in either Rust or Typescript (Node.js)

  • Experience building highly-available API services within container-based environments (e.g., Docker, ECS, Kubernetes, etc. on AWS)

  • Proficiency in implementing monitoring instrumentation, triaging incidents, resolving customer issues, and continuous product improvement

  • Knowledge of operating systems and distributed systems (e.g., fault-tolerance, consistency, service discovery, etc.)

  • Proven ability to design long-term technical strategies that balance immediate product delivery with the reduction of systemic technical debt across multiple departments

  • Extensive experience driving high-visibility initiatives that improve engineering standards and operational excellence for the cross-functional teams

  • Strong English verbal and written communication skills (B2 level minimum). Mapbox has offices across the globe. You should communicate about complex ideas concisely to an audience worldwide

  • Experience or interest in solving geo-spatial problems

Candidates should also have:

  • A desire to work with individuals with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences

  • Enthusiasm for learning and knowledge sharing in a multidisciplinary environment, supported by mentorship experience and strong written and verbal communication skills

  • A rigorous approach to problem solving, using experiments and data analysis to drive quality of service improvements

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.


Employment Requirements

  • Employment Type: Full-time

  • Weekly Hours: 40 h per week

  • Location/Hybrid Policy: Remote (from any city in Germany)

How we support you

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have received the Mapbox Non-US Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here. Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application.

We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.

descriptionHtml:

Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What You'll Do

Solutions Architects are trusted technical and business advisors who partner with customers to design, prototype, and deliver solutions on the Mapbox platform. You will work directly with customers and account teams to discover needs, design architectures, and deliver solutions that turn data, mobility, and mapping into effective digital experiences and measurable business outcomes. This role is ideal for someone who combines technical depth with commercial acumen and thrives at the intersection of strategy, architecture, and delivery. Successful candidates typically have a mix of software engineering, product management, solutions engineering, and technical consulting experience prior to this role.

Core responsibilities

  • Partner with Sales to position Mapbox’s technical value and shape opportunities.

  • Lead technical discovery to understand customer goals, requirements, and success criteria, and ensure solution designs meet business objectives.

  • Design and present scalable architectures using Mapbox SDKs, APIs, and platform services.

  • Respond to technical customer requests (RFI/RFQ) with clear technical documentation and solution proposals.

  • Provide technical guidance during the pre-sales cycle and deliver rapid technical enablement via workshops, demos, and PoC/PoV in a fast-paced digital customer environment.

  • Drive customer success by accelerating time-to-value and supporting adoption and expansion in a dynamic, complex ecosystem.

  • Advocate for customer needs and provide structured feedback to influence product and engineering direction.

  • Stay current on mapping, mobility, and AI technologies and share best practices internally and with customers.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  •  5+ years in solutions architecture, customer-facing engineering (pre-sales, post-sales), or consulting.

  • Native-level Mandarin and English fluency: Exemplary written and verbal communication skills in both languages.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (preferred).

  • Knowledge of web and mobile technologies (JavaScript, Android, iOS).

  • Experience building applications that integrate back-end APIs and front-end SDKs.

  • Experience of GIS, location intelligence, geospatial data, and mapping is a plus.

  • Experience with AI technologies is a plus.

  • Experience leading technical responses for RFI/RFQ, crafting comprehensive technical proposals.

What You'll Do

As Head of Sales, Renewals, you will own the strategy, operating model, and commercial performance of our Renewals organization. This is a Director-level leadership role for a seasoned sales leader responsible for scaling a high-performing team of 8 Account Managers, driving long-term ARR retention, and ensuring the commercial health of our recurring revenue base. As a player-coach, you will personally engage in the most strategic, complex, or at-risk customer situations—including executive conversations, major renewals, commercial negotiations, and expansion opportunities—when senior leadership involvement can materially improve the outcome.

  •  Lead, develop, and scale a team of 8 Account Managers, setting clear expectations, establishing rigorous operating rhythms, coaching toward exceptional performance, and developing talent and career paths across the team.

  • Define and scale the renewal organization's strategy, processes, and systems to support Mapbox's long-term ARR goals.

  • Act as a key stakeholder within the leadership team, collaborating with Product and Engineering leadership to drive customer-centric product roadmaps based on renewal insights.

  • Leverage data analytics to identify market trends, structural risks, and growth opportunities, transforming insights into long-term organizational strategy.

  • Personally engage in the most strategic, complex, or at-risk renewals and expansions, partnering with Account Managers on executive engagement, negotiation strategy, pricing, usage commitments, and contract structure.

  • Lead commercial strategy for high-stakes renewals and expansion opportunities, balancing customer value, long-term partnership, deal structure, and Mapbox's growth objectives.

  • Build a culture of proactive customer value realization, helping the team understand customer business priorities, product adoption, usage trends, and organizational dynamics to protect and grow recurring revenue.

  • Drive expansion across the existing customer base by identifying opportunities to increase adoption of Mapbox products, including Maps, Search, Navigation, Movement, Atlas, and emerging products.

  • Coach the team on building multi-threaded customer relationships across Product, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, and executive stakeholders, reducing dependency on individual champions and strengthening long-term customer relationships.

  • Lead weekly renewal and deal inspection, forecast reviews, and account planning, creating a rigorous operating cadence that surfaces risk, opportunity, and required actions early.

  • Own the accuracy and predictability of the renewal forecast, driving strong Salesforce discipline and ensuring leadership has clear visibility into renewal health, risks, expansion opportunities, and expected outcomes.

  • Bring customer and market insights back into Mapbox, helping the broader organization understand the factors driving retention, adoption, and expansion across our customer base.

  • Set the standard for commercial excellence within the Renewals organization, modeling strong negotiation, executive engagement, account planning, commercial judgment, and customer value creation.

  • Serve as a key member of the sales leadership team, contributing to broader go-to-market strategy and helping shape how Mapbox retains, grows, and deepens customer relationships.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  •  10+ years of experience in Account Management, Renewals, Customer Growth, or enterprise sales teams, including at least 5+ years experience leading and developing high-performing sales teams.

  • Proven track record of delivering strong gross retention, net retention, renewal, and expansion results within a complex enterprise software or technology environment.

  • Experience managing large, strategic enterprise renewals, including complex pricing, procurement, negotiation, usage commitments, and contract discussions.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify renewal risk early, develop effective mitigation strategies, and mobilize internal and customer stakeholders around a path to resolution.

  • Strong commercial instincts with the ability to uncover expansion opportunities and help teams grow existing customer relationships.

  • Experience building multi-threaded relationships across Product, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, and executive stakeholders.

  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to lead difficult commercial conversations with both customers and senior Mapbox leaders.

  • Comfortable orchestrating cross-functional teams without direct authority and creating accountability around customer and business outcomes.

  • Strong background in location technology, developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, or adjacent technical fields is preferred.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities, customer needs, and product capabilities continue to evolve.

  • Curious, adaptable, commercially minded, and energized by Mapbox's complexity. You understand that modern renewals leadership goes beyond managing contracts—it's about building a great team, demonstrating customer value, driving adoption, protecting recurring revenue, and creating sustainable customer growth.

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

How We Support You

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Comprehensive Healthcare: Private medical coverage for you and your dependents.

  • Family-First Support: Generous maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Fertility & Family Building: Inclusive fertility support. Grow your family on your terms.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth.

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Flexible paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

  • Invest & Grow: Retirement plans with competitive matching.

Our annual on target compensation for this role ranges from $357,000 - $483,000. Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location. Please discuss your specific work location with your recruiter for more information.

title: Software Development Engineer II (Senior Data Engineer), HD Core
descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What We Do

On the HD Maps team, we are at the forefront of geospatial big-data analytics and insights for customer market segments and product offerings. Our expertise is pivotal in deploying GIS algorithmic stages into scalable production cloud applications, leveraging platforms like AWS and Spark. We work on Mapbox's award-winning high-precision maps (“HD Maps”) product family, spanning across ADAS, AV, and Non-Automotive GIS data customers in numerous projects. We cover everything from data and systems analysis to automotive and cloud application architecture, including compute, storage, cost, and performance assessments.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Software Development Engineer you can expect to:

  • Lead the initiation, design (requirements and specifications), and building of the product roadmap for algorithmic stages within cloud applications.

  • Code and develop relevant algorithmic stages within cloud applications, utilizing technologies such as Python, SQL, AWS, and Spark, while ensuring high scalability.

  • Collaborate across multiple R&D teams to seamlessly integrate analytics solutions into our mapping products.

  • Work closely with engineering teams to align product development with strategic objectives.

  • Engage in direct communication with trend-setting customers.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • Expert knowledge of at least one programming language (Python, Scala, or Java) and strong software engineering fundamentals.

  • Extensive experience designing and building large-scale data processing applications and pipelines on AWS or another cloud platform.

  • Strong SQL skills with deep understanding of query optimization, execution planning, and large-scale data processing.

  • Deep understanding of distributed computing principles and hands-on experience with frameworks such as Spark.

  • Experience designing and maintaining reliable data workflows using orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or Luigi.

  • Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, testing strategies, and CI/CD practices.

  • Experience making architectural and technical decisions, balancing scalability, reliability, and maintainability.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to drive complex technical initiatives.

  • Excellent communication skills and experience collaborating across cross-functional teams.

  • Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Nice to Have Traits for This Role

  • Prior experience in the mapping, navigation, or automotive industry.

  • Knowledge of machine learning techniques for geospatial data analysis.

  • Contributions to open-source geospatial or data analysis projects.

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this mission through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

How we support you

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

title: Senior Manager, Driver Operations
descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What We Do

The Navigation team are proud builders of solutions to challenges in the routing space for industries like auto, logistics, outdoors and more. We solve complex geospatial data problems and leverage algorithms and statistical analysis for use cases ranging from turn-by-turn navigation, to delivery route planning for fleets of thousands of trucks. Our services are at the heart of the operations of our customers’ businesses. We get people and products from start to finish effectively and on time, whether it’s delivering meals or going on a road trip. Our customers are primarily developers, like us.

What You'll Do

We’re looking for a Senior Manager of Driver Operations to build and scale a best-in-class, global driver operations program that directly powers the quality of our navigation products. This role sits at the critical intersection of real-world driving and product development where you’ll help ensure we consistently deliver high-quality products as we expand into new geographies.

In this role, you’ll lead operational programs that support some of our most strategic automotive customers, ensuring our technology performs seamlessly in real-world conditions across global markets. You’re a creative, systems-oriented thinker who is deeply curious about customers and serves as a key player in showcasing our technology to customers through live demos and field activation. You bring a high level of organization and follow-through, with the ability to coordinate effectively across teams and drive initiatives end-to-end. You communicate clearly, collaborate seamlessly, and approach software development as a collective effort.

As a Senior Manager you can expect to:

  • Launch and manage global driver testing programs, translating high-level strategy into clear, executable plans across geographies.

  • Hire, train and lead full-time Driver Operations team, while maintaining a network of local resources who can temporarily augment team capacity in key markets.

  • Manage and lead customer facing demos of in-car software.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering teams to design and evolve in-car test plans across all driving-specific features and use cases.

  • Travel approximately once per month (or more) to support global programs, on-the-ground testing, and customer engagements.

  • Lead execution of testing programs, ensuring high-quality, actionable bug reports, logs, tickets, and feedback are delivered to engineering.

  • Oversee the production of detailed test outputs – including videos, traces, and logs, providing initial analysis of the issue using engineering provided tools or AI tools.

  • Define KPIs and benchmark metrics for measuring results of drive testing. Pull these metrics, analyze results, and synthesize learnings to support continuous software improvement.

  • Create dashboards, benchmarks, and reports (Excel, slides) to clearly communicate performance metrics, trends, and findings to cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Streamline stakeholder communications end-to-end; partner closely with our customers, Engineering Managers, Engineers, Product Managers, Executives, Support, and TPMs.

  • Manage a small fleet of vehicles internationally, including parking, insurance, certifications, and regulatory compliance.

  • Uphold a culture of collaboration, transparency, creativity, inclusion, and data-driven decision making.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  •  5+ years of operations and/or program experience: Proven track record managing teams while deploying people and resources across multiple locations, ideally within fleet operations or field operations.

  • Strong technical and analytical mindset: Comfortable working with data to evaluate product performance and operational efficiency. SQL proficiency is expected, along with the ability to translate real-world driver feedback into structured, actionable insights for engineering and product teams.

  • Tolerance for ambiguity and intrinsic motivation: You thrive in undefined spaces and can bring structure to chaos. You can weed out what’s important in highly ambiguous spaces, and juggle a variety of competing priorities. Even so, you are proactive around driving solutions to completion.

  • Excellent communication skills (technical + external): Able to clearly articulate complex ideas to a wide range of audiences – from engineers to executives to external partners. Comfortable representing the product in customer facing settings, including live demons and field activations.

  • Highly organized and execution-oriented: Strong operator who can manage multiple programs, with ability to follow through and close loops consistently.

  • Systems thinker with a focus on scalability: Passionate about building repeatable processes, measurement frameworks, and operational infrastructure that enable programs to scale efficiently.

  • Empathy and collaboration: Communicate and build trust effectively across various functions, teams, and stakeholders. Comfortable giving and receiving feedback, and able to influence without authority in highly cross-functional environments.

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • Comprehensive Healthcare: Private medical coverage for you and your dependents.

  • Family-First Support: Generous maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager of Driver Operations to build and scale a best-in-class, global driver operations program that directly powers the quality of our navigation products. This role sits at the critical intersection of real-world driving and product development where you’ll help ensure we consistently deliver high-quality products as we expand into new geographies.

In this role, you’ll lead operational programs that support some of our most strategic automotive customers, ensuring our technology performs seamlessly in real-world conditions across global markets. You’re a creative, systems-oriented thinker who is deeply curious about customers and serves as a key player in showcasing our technology to customers through live demos and field activation. You bring a high level of organization and follow-through, with the ability to coordinate effectively across teams and drive initiatives end-to-end. You communicate clearly, collaborate seamlessly, and approach software development as a collective effort.




AS A SENIOR MANAGER YOU CAN EXPECT TO:

 - Launch and manage global driver testing programs, translating high-level strategy into clear, executable plans across geographies.

 - Hire, train and lead full-time Driver Operations team, while maintaining a network of local resources who can temporarily augment team capacity in key markets.

 - Manage and lead customer facing demos of in-car software.

 - Partner with Product and Engineering teams to design and evolve in-car test plans across all driving-specific features and use cases.

 - Travel approximately once per month (or more) to support global programs, on-the-ground testing, and customer engagements.

 - Lead execution of testing programs, ensuring high-quality, actionable bug reports, logs, tickets, and feedback are delivered to engineering.

 - Oversee the production of detailed test outputs – including videos, traces, and logs, providing initial analysis of the issue using engineering provided tools or AI tools.

 - Define KPIs and benchmark metrics for measuring results of drive testing. Pull these metrics, analyze results, and synthesize learnings to support continuous software improvement.

 - Create dashboards, benchmarks, and reports (Excel, slides) to clearly communicate performance metrics, trends, and findings to cross-functional stakeholders.

 - Streamline stakeholder communications end-to-end; partner closely with our customers, Engineering Managers, Engineers, Product Managers, Executives, Support, and TPMs.

 - Manage a small fleet of vehicles internationally, including parking, insurance, certifications, and regulatory compliance.

 - Uphold a culture of collaboration, transparency, creativity, inclusion, and data-driven decision making.
   
   


WHAT WE BELIEVE ARE IMPORTANT TRAITS FOR THIS ROLE

 -  5+ years of operations and/or program experience: Proven track record managing teams while deploying people and resources across multiple locations, ideally within fleet operations or field operations.

 - Strong technical and analytical mindset: Comfortable working with data to evaluate product performance and operational efficiency. SQL proficiency is expected, along with the ability to translate real-world driver feedback into structured, actionable insights for engineering and product teams.

 - Tolerance for ambiguity and intrinsic motivation: You thrive in undefined spaces and can bring structure to chaos. You can weed out what’s important in highly ambiguous spaces, and juggle a variety of competing priorities. Even so, you are  proactive around driving solutions to completion.

 - Excellent communication skills (technical + external): Able to clearly articulate complex ideas to a wide range of audiences – from engineers to executives to external partners. Comfortable representing the product in customer facing settings, including live demons and field activations.

 - Highly organized and execution-oriented: Strong operator who can manage multiple programs, with ability to follow through and close loops consistently.

 - Systems thinker with a focus on scalability: Passionate about building repeatable processes, measurement frameworks, and operational infrastructure that enable programs to scale efficiently.

 - Empathy and collaboration: Communicate and build trust effectively across various functions, teams, and stakeholders. Comfortable giving and receiving feedback, and able to influence without authority in highly cross-functional environments.




WHAT WE VALUE

In addition to our core values https://www.mapbox.com/about/values/, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

 - We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

 - We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

 - We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

 - We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.


HOW WE SUPPORT YOU

 - Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

 - Comprehensive Healthcare: Private medical coverage for you and your dependents.

 - Family-First Support: Generous maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

 - Fertility & Family Building: Inclusive fertility support. Grow your family on your terms.

 - Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth.

 - Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

 - Rest & Recharge: Flexible paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

 - Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

 - Invest & Grow: Retirement plans with competitive matching.

 

Our annual base compensation for this role ranges from $142,800 - $193,200 for most US locations and 5% to 10% higher for US locations with a higher cost of labor. Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location. Please discuss your specific work location with your recruiter for more information.

descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

Mapbox Japan은 미래를 바꾸는 동료를 찾고 있습니다. ✨

지도·모빌리티·위치 테크놀로지에 두근두근하는 분, 꼭 봐 주세요!

솔루션 아키텍트로서 글로벌 OEM에서 국내 스타트 업까지

폭넓은 고객과 함께 차세대 이동 체험을 디자인해 나가는 포지션입니다.

What You'll Do

Solutions Architects are trusted technical and business advisors who partner with customers to design, prototype, and deliver solutions on the Mapbox platform. You will work directly with customers and account teams to discover needs, design architectures, and deliver solutions that turn data, mobility, and mapping into effective digital experiences and measurable business outcomes. This role is ideal for someone who combines technical depth with commercial acumen and thrives at the intersection of strategy, architecture, and delivery. Successful candidates typically have a mix of software engineering, product management, solutions engineering, and technical consulting experience prior to this role.

Core responsibilities

  • Partner with Sales to position Mapbox’s technical value and shape opportunities.

  • Lead technical discovery to understand customer goals, requirements, and success criteria, and ensure solution designs meet business objectives.

  • Design and present scalable architectures using Mapbox SDKs, APIs, and platform services.

  • Respond to technical customer requests (RFI/RFQ) with clear technical documentation and solution proposals.

  • Provide technical guidance during the pre-sales cycle and deliver rapid technical enablement via workshops, demos, and PoC/PoV in a fast-paced digital customer environment.

  • Drive customer success by accelerating time-to-value and supporting adoption and expansion in a dynamic, complex ecosystem.

  • Advocate for customer needs and provide structured feedback to influence product and engineering direction.

  • Stay current on mapping, mobility, and AI technologies and share best practices internally and with customers.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 5+ years in solutions architecture, customer-facing engineering (pre-sales, post-sales), or consulting.

  • Fluent in Korean and English (both written and verbal communication)

  • Location: Must reside in Japan or South Korea

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (preferred).

  • Knowledge of web and mobile technologies (JavaScript, Android, iOS).

  • Experience building applications that integrate back-end APIs and front-end SDKs.

  • Experience of GIS, location intelligence, geospatial data, and mapping is a plus.

  • Experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.

  • Experience with AI technologies is a plus.

  • Experience leading technical responses for RFI/RFQ, crafting comprehensive technical proposals.

  • Strong business acumen and comfort working autonomously across distributed teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex requirements into scalable, robust architectures aligned with customer objectives.

  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and executive audiences, combined with a proven ability to influence executive, product, engineering, and developer stakeholders.

  • Experience collaborating with OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers.

  • Understanding of the Automotive industry and its ecosystem technologies such as navigation, autonomous driving, ADAS, ISA, and software-defined vehicles.

  • Willingness to travel up to 25% for customer meetings, workshops, and industry events

  • Please submit your resume and application in English.

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have received the Mapbox Non-US Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here.  Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application. 

We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.

title: Software Development Engineer III, Routing Cost
descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What We Do

The Navigation team at Mapbox develops and operates web services powering virtually all of Mapbox’s strategic navigation initiatives in consumer, automotive, and logistics verticals. We are a highly multidisciplinary organization, with work spanning distributed systems on AWS to geospatial localization, traffic telemetry, and mapping.

Collectively we are revolutionizing in-car experiences with technology to build fast, industry-leading maps and navigation for any vehicle. We’ve launched products such as MapGPT, Mapbox for EV, and we’re enhancing the visual experience of in-vehicle navigation with 3D styling with our new Mapbox Standard through web and mobile SDKs. Mapbox has worked with automotive partners—including BMW, Toyota, and GM—to bring the best aspects of mobile app development into in-vehicle navigation and infotainment.

Mapbox Blog: Introducing 3D Live Navigation

Mapbox Blog: Route Notifications Improve Driver Safety

Mapbox Newsroom: AI Features in New Navigation SDK

What You'll Do

As a Software Development Engineer III on the Routing Cost team, you will lead the design, development, and delivery of highly trafficked production systems for our routing cost engine. Your technical contributions will include:

  • Lead the engineering team(s) to execute end-to-end feature implementation within the larger navigation organization (~80 engineers).

  • Design and implement scalable services for our API and routing engine tiers, following best practices for deployment, resilience, and observability.

  • Run and design experiments to evaluate the quality, reliability, and capacity requirements of our user-facing navigation products.

  • Work with product owners, sales engineering, and management to drive future product direction.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  •  8-10+ years of engineering experience: Extensive hands-on experience showcasing expertise and a strong track record in the field.

  • Technical knowledge: Extensive experience coding in a variety of languages such as C++, Python, and/or Rust. Deep knowledge of different data structures and algorithms, design patterns, memory management, multithreading, and performance optimization for high-efficiency applications.

  • Cloud proficiency: Extensive experience with cloud database services, including AWS RDS, Google Cloud Spanner, and Azure SQL, as well as deploying and managing databases in cloud environments.

  • Operational excellence: You drive a culture of quality and continuous improvement in your organization. Strong passion for clean code and robust architecture, with a drive to elevate engineering practices and design standards across the team.

  • Ownership & execution: Own the technical vision, lead the strategy and guide the team to execute towards building the future of our routing cost engine.

  • Customer focus: You care deeply about your customers and their problems, and you work tirelessly to innovate on their behalf.

  • Growth mindset: Have the humility to accept mistakes, learn and grow from them.

  • Mentorship: Experience mentoring and leading engineering teams developing skill sets and career growth.

  • Strong written and vocal communication skills: You can talk and write about complex ideas concisely to a wide audience. You are able to lead and resolve org-wide technical discussions and are able to collaborate and include input from cross-functional teams (security, devops, data, compliance and product).

  • Data informed mindset: You believe in the value of data informed decision making and strive to measure things that are not straight forward but essential. You also have the right instincts to make speedy decisions in the absence of perfect & comprehensive data.

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

How we support you

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

What We Do

Our team is responsible for the Directions and Logistics APIs, which power everything from a single driver's route request to the complex logistics optimization for major delivery companies. We handle millions of requests daily, operating under strict latency requirements, making our work both challenging and highly rewarding. Given the essential nature of our services, we maintain a responsible on-call rotation and treat alarms seriously to ensure system stability without excessive noise.
We have an exciting roadmap for 2026, and this is the perfect time to join us to be a part of this exciting journey!

As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include a discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.

What You’ll Do

As a Staff Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing and operating significant areas of our routing services. In this role, you can expect to:

  • Design and implement scalable services for our API and routing engine tiers, following best practices for deployment, resilience, and observability.

  • Design and improve services that power the data consumption and storage of the routing data.

  • Drive the design, development, and testing of Mapbox tools

  • Shape internal tools and automations to make the whole engineering life easier and fun.

  • Drive design and development of services quality metrics and analytics.

  • Run and design experiments to evaluate the quality, reliability, and capacity requirements of our user-facing navigation products.

  • Participate in end-to-end feature implementation within the larger navigation team; review code and design documents, shepherd feature releases, and participate in an on-call rotation.

  • Work with product owners, sales engineering, and management to drive future product direction.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 12/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

Navigation API services interact with many internal systems at Mapbox, making this a high-visibility team with great opportunities to collaborate across the company.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • Experience in engineering web services in either Rust or Typescript (Node.js)

  • Experience building highly-available API services within container-based environments (e.g., Docker, ECS, Kubernetes, etc. on AWS).

  • Proficiency in implementing monitoring instrumentation, triaging incidents, resolving customer issues, and continuous product improvement.

  • Knowledge of operating systems and distributed systems (e.g., fault-tolerance, consistency, service discovery, etc.)

  • Proven ability to design long-term technical strategies that balance immediate product delivery with the reduction of systemic technical debt across multiple departments.

  • Extensive experience driving high-visibility initiatives that improve engineering standards and operational excellence for the cross-functional teams

  • Strong English verbal and written communication skills. Mapbox has offices across the globe. You should communicate about complex ideas concisely to an audience worldwide.

  • Experience or interest in solving geo-spatial problems.

Candidates should also have:

  • A desire to work with individuals with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

  • Enthusiasm for learning and knowledge sharing in a multidisciplinary environment, supported by mentorship experience and strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • A rigorous approach to problem solving, using experiments and data analysis to drive quality of service improvements.

descriptionPlain:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 




WHAT WE DO

Our team is responsible for the Directions and Logistics APIs, which power everything from a single driver's route request to the complex logistics optimization for major delivery companies. We handle millions of requests daily, operating under strict latency requirements, making our work both challenging and highly rewarding. Given the essential nature of our services, we maintain a responsible on-call rotation and treat alarms seriously to ensure system stability without excessive noise. 
We have an exciting roadmap for 2026, and this is the perfect time to join us to be a part of this exciting journey!

As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include a discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Staff Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing and operating significant areas of our routing services. In this role, you can expect to:

 - Design and implement scalable services for our API and routing engine tiers, following best practices for deployment, resilience, and observability.

 - Design and improve services that power the data consumption and storage of the routing data.

 - Drive the design, development, and testing of Mapbox tools

 - Shape internal tools and automations to make the whole engineering life easier and fun.

 - Drive design and development of services quality metrics and analytics.

 - Run and design experiments to evaluate the quality, reliability, and capacity requirements of our user-facing navigation products.

 - Participate in end-to-end feature implementation within the larger navigation team; review code and design documents, shepherd feature releases, and participate in an on-call rotation.

 - Work with product owners, sales engineering, and management to drive future product direction.

 - Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 12/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

Navigation API services interact with many internal systems at Mapbox, making this a high-visibility team with great opportunities to collaborate across the company.




WHAT WE BELIEVE ARE IMPORTANT TRAITS FOR THIS ROLE

 - Experience in engineering web services in either Rust or Typescript (Node.js)

 - Experience building highly-available API services within container-based environments (e.g., Docker, ECS, Kubernetes, etc. on AWS).

 - Proficiency in implementing monitoring instrumentation, triaging incidents, resolving customer issues, and continuous product improvement.

 - Knowledge of operating systems and distributed systems (e.g., fault-tolerance, consistency, service discovery, etc.)

 - Proven ability to design long-term technical strategies that balance immediate product delivery with the reduction of systemic technical debt across multiple departments.

 - Extensive experience driving high-visibility initiatives that improve engineering standards and operational excellence for the cross-functional teams

 - Strong English verbal and written communication skills. Mapbox has offices across the globe. You should communicate about complex ideas concisely to an audience worldwide.

 - Experience or interest in solving geo-spatial problems.

Candidates should also have:

 - A desire to work with individuals with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

 - Enthusiasm for learning and knowledge sharing in a multidisciplinary environment, supported by mentorship experience and strong written and verbal communication skills.

 - A rigorous approach to problem solving, using experiments and data analysis to drive quality of service improvements.




WHAT WE VALUE

In addition to our core values https://www.mapbox.com/about/values/, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

 - We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

 - We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

 - We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

 - We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.
   
   


HOW WE SUPPORT YOU

 - Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

title: Senior/Staff Software Development Engineer, EV Platform
descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

Senior/Staff Software Development Engineer, EV Platform

Mapboxは、次世代のロケーションベースのビジネスを支える、世界をリードするリアルタイム・ロケーションプラットフォームです。人、モノ、車両の移動をあらゆる場所で支えるために必要なツールを包括的に提供する、唯一のプラットフォームです。

その柔軟性、高いセキュリティ、プライバシーへの配慮が評価され、世界で400万人を超える登録開発者に選ばれています。企業や組織は、Mapboxのアプリケーション、データ、SDK、APIを活用し、それぞれのニーズに合わせた魅力的で没入感のある体験を創り出しています。

What We Do

EV Platformチームは、Mapboxの電気自動車（EV）向けプロダクトを支える、充電インフラのデータ基盤を担っています。世界各地の充電ポイント事業者（CPO）からリアルタイムおよび静的なEV充電ステーションデータを収集・処理し、本番環境でこれらのデータを利用する自動車・モビリティ分野のお客様に、信頼性、正確性、鮮度の高いデータを提供しています。

私たちは、世界中のCPOエコシステムと、お客様がエンドユーザーに提供するナビゲーション体験をつなぐ、データ取り込みパイプライン、品質保証システム、APIの開発・運用を行っています。新たなデータソースの統合から、大規模にデータを提供するシステムの安定稼働まで、データライフサイクル全体をチームで担っています。また、私たちが生成するデータは、Search、Map Data、RoutingをはじめとするMapboxのさまざまなプロダクトやチームで活用されています。そのため、社内でも注目度が高く、幅広い領域に大きなインパクトを与えるチームです。

MapboxのEV向けソリューションについて、詳しくはこちらをご覧ください。

https://www.mapbox.com/ev

https://www.mapbox.com/blog/mapbox-for-ev

AIが現代のエンジニアリングワークフローにますます組み込まれるなか、私たちは、設計、開発、意思決定の各プロセスにAIを適切かつ効果的に取り入れられるエンジニアを重視しています。選考プロセスでは、日々のエンジニアリング業務でAIをどのように活用しているかについてもお伺いします。

What You'll Do

EV PlatformチームのSenior Backend Engineerとして、Mapboxがグローバルに提供するEV充電ステーションデータを支えるデータインフラの開発に携わります。世界各地の充電ポイント事業者（CPO）やデータアグリゲーターから取得したデータを処理するデータ取り込みパイプライン、データの正確性を維持する品質管理システム、そしてお客様や社内チームにデータを提供するAPIなどを担当します。

具体的には、以下のようなプロジェクトに携わります。

  • 新たな地域の充電ポイント事業者（CPO）との連携を進め、EV充電ステーションデータのグローバルなカバレッジを拡大する

  • 複数のデータプロバイダーから取得した充電ステーションデータを照合・統合し、信頼できる単一のデータセットを構築するシステムを開発する

  • データ取り込みパイプラインの信頼性と処理能力を向上させ、大規模なデータ処理に対応できるよう拡張する

  • 充電ステーションの各種属性やリアルタイムの利用可能状況の正確性を確保するため、データ検証・品質管理システムを設計する

  • データの健全性をモニタリングし、修正が必要なデータを検出・可視化するための社内ツールやダッシュボードを開発する

  • EV充電データを各プロダクトで活用するMapbox社内のチームを技術面から支援する

このポジションでは、以下の業務を担当します。

  • 拡張性の高いデータパイプラインおよびバックエンドサービスを設計・実装し、デプロイ、耐障害性、オブザーバビリティに関するベストプラクティスに沿って開発・運用する

  • EV充電データの品質、正確性、カバレッジを評価するための実験を設計・実施する

  • Mapboxの幅広いプロダクトエコシステムの中で、機能の設計から実装・リリースまで一貫して携わる。コードレビューや設計ドキュメントのレビュー、機能リリースの推進、オンコール対応を担当する

  • プロダクトオーナー、関連チーム、マネジメントと連携し、今後のデータプラットフォームの方向性を策定・推進する

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 本番環境のバックエンドサービス開発における、3年以上のRustを使用した実務経験と高いスキルをお持ちの方

  • AWS上のコンテナベース環境において、高可用性のバックエンドサービスやデータパイプラインを構築した経験をお持ちの方。Docker、ECS、Fargate、Kubernetesなどの利用経験に加え、サービスのモニタリング、インシデント対応、継続的なプロダクト改善に実践的に取り組んだ経験をお持ちの方。ArgoおよびDatadogの利用経験があれば尚可

  • パイプライン設計、データ品質の検証、大規模データ処理など、データエンジニアリングに関する知識をお持ちの方

  • 耐障害性、整合性、サービスディスカバリなど、分散システムに関する知識をお持ちの方。システムアーキテクチャの設計経験とアーキテクチャに関する理解があり、データ分析やパフォーマンスプロファイリングに基づいてサービスを改善できる方

  • チームワークを重視し、協力的な環境の中で周囲と連携しながら業務を進められる方

  • 新しいことを学び、知識を積極的に共有する姿勢を持ち、英語で円滑にコミュニケーションできる方

  • プログラミングへの高い関心と、品質を重視する姿勢をお持ちの方。自動テストの実装経験をお持ちの方

What We Value

このポジションに限らず、Mapboxのすべてのリーダーに共通して求められるコアバリューに加え、私たちは以下の考え方を大切にしています。

  • 課題や新たな可能性に深く向き合い、高い成果を生み出す創造性豊かな人材を大切にしています。

  • 一人ひとりが自分らしく働けることを大切にしています。そのために、充実したヘルスケア制度や育児休暇、ライフイベントに柔軟に対応できる働き方を整えるとともに、社員をより良くサポートするための仕組みを継続的に進化させています。

  • 社員一人ひとりがそれぞれの役割で、そしてMapboxの一員として活躍するために必要な知識やスキルを身につけられるよう、互いに教え、学び合う環境を重視しています。

  • 多様な人材が集まるチームを育てることには大きな価値があると考えています。バックグラウンド、性別、人種・民族、障がいの有無、性的指向などにかかわらず、あらゆる方からのご応募を歓迎します。

このポジションに応募することにより、応募者向けのMapbox Privacy Noticeをご確認いただいたものとみなされます。応募手続きには、氏名や連絡先などの個人情報のご提供が必要です。これらの情報は、Mapboxが応募を受け付け、選考を行うために必要となります。

Mapboxは、公正かつ公平な採用プロセスの実現に取り組んでいます。法令で保護されるいかなる属性を理由とする差別も行いません。

Mapboxは、敬意に満ち、プロフェッショナルで安全な採用プロセスの提供に努めています。面接や候補者との連絡を含むすべての採用活動は、会社が承認した方法およびチャネルを通じて厳格に実施されます。


Senior/Staff Software Development Engineer, EV Platform

What We Do

The EV Platform team powers the charging infrastructure data layer behind Mapbox's electric vehicle products. Our services aggregate and process real-time and static EV charging station data from charge point operators around the world, making it reliable, accurate, and fresh for the automotive and mobility customers who depend on it in production.

We build and operate the data ingestion pipelines, quality assurance systems, and APIs that sit between the global CPO ecosystem and the navigation experiences our customers ship to end users. The team owns the full data lifecycle, from integrating new data sources to ensuring the operational health of the systems delivering that data at scale. The data we produce flows downstream into many other Mapbox products and teams, including search, map data, and routing, making this a high-visibility team with broad impact across the company.

Read more about Mapbox for EV:

https://www.mapbox.com/ev

https://www.mapbox.com/blog/mapbox-for-ev

As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.


What You'll Do

As a Senior Backend Engineer on the EV Platform team you will be working on the data infrastructure that powers Mapbox's global EV charging station coverage. This includes the ingestion pipeline that processes data from a global network of charge point operators and data aggregators, the quality systems that keep that data accurate, and the APIs that serve it to customers and internal teams.

Projects you might take part in:

  • Expanding global EV charging coverage by integrating with new charge point operators across new regions

  • Building systems that reconcile and unify charging station data across multiple providers into a single authoritative dataset

  • Building and scaling the data ingestion pipeline for higher reliability and throughput

  • Designing data validation and quality systems to ensure accuracy of charging station attributes and live availability

  • Developing internal tooling and dashboards to monitor data health and surface corrections

  • Supporting downstream Mapbox teams consuming EV charging data in their products

In this role, you will be expected to:

  • Design and implement scalable data pipelines and backend services, following best practices for deployment, resilience, and observability

  • Run and design experiments to evaluate the quality, accuracy, and coverage of EV charging data

  • Participate in end-to-end feature implementation within the larger Mapbox ecosystem; review code and design documents, shepherd feature releases, and participate in an on-call rotation

  • Work with product owners, partner teams, and management to drive future data platform direction

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • Strong proficiency in Rust (3+ years) for production backend services.

  • Experience building highly available backend services and data pipelines in container-based environments on AWS, including Docker, ECS, Fargate, or Kubernetes, with hands-on experience in service monitoring, incident triage, and continuous product improvement. Familiarity with Argo and Datadog is a plus.

  • Knowledge of data engineering concepts, including pipeline design, data quality validation, and large-scale data processing.

  • Knowledge of distributed systems (fault-tolerance, consistency, service discovery). System architecture experience and understanding of architectural concepts. Ability to improve services based on data analysis and performance profiling.

  • Being an excellent team player with the ability to work within a collaborative environment.

  • Enthusiasm for learning and knowledge sharing, supported by strong communication skills in English.

  • Passion about programming and a strong focus on quality. Implementation of automated tests.

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have received the Mapbox Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here. Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application.

We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.

Mapbox is committed to providing a respectful, professional, and safe recruiting experience. All recruiting activities, including interviews and candidate communications, are strictly conducted through company-approved methods and channels.
